policies.text: Safety and compliance standards are fulfilled when a transit firm records a driver training completion rate of at least 90 percent this year together with an active fleet count of at least 12 coaches.
Authorization for urban transit routes is granted to any transport vendor holding an active municipal transit license.
Awarding of executive VIP transportation agreements requires a charter company to demonstrate charter standing at the elite level.

Criteria for high-volume operators are met if a provider maintains a private jet fleet of at least 15 jets, or reports annual revenue of at least 20,000,000 USD this year, or holds an ARGUS safety rating of at least 5 stars.
Passenger punctuality benchmarks are satisfied when a train operator achieves an on-time arrival rate of at least 90 percent this year.
Selection for cross-border transit assignments requires a carrier to possess top-level safety clearance.
Terminal expansion at airports is approved for aviation businesses that secure preferred hangar lease eligibility.
An operator fulfills fundamental fleet capacity standards when maintaining an active fleet count of at least 10 coaches.
An operator attains preferred carrier ranking if it fulfills fundamental fleet capacity standards and concurrently satisfies safety and compliance standards.
Top-level safety clearance is granted when an operator holds preferred carrier ranking along with an active ISO 39001 certification.
Eco-friendly lodging accreditation is conferred on hospitality venues demonstrating an annual energy reduction rate of at least 15 percent.
Maritime freight permits are issued to shipping lines maintaining an international vessel security certification.

Regional expansion funding eligibility is granted if a charter firm recorded at least 100 charter flights completed last quarter, operates a private jet fleet of at least 15 jets, and maintains a customer satisfaction score of at least 90 percent.
Charter standing at the elite level is awarded when an aviation firm fulfills criteria for high-volume operators while possessing an active Wyvern Wingman certificate.
Preferred hangar lease eligibility is extended to any flight company that possesses regional expansion funding eligibility.
